**Attendance Policy**

• Minimum **75% attendance** is mandatory for all students to be eligible to write semester examinations.
• Attendance is calculated subject-wise for each theory and practical class.
• Students with attendance below 75% may not be allowed to appear for exams.
• Medical leave with valid medical certificate is accepted (submitted within 3 days).
• Students with attendance below 60% will require a meeting with parents/guardians.

**Attendance Exemptions**

• **Medical Leave**: Submit valid medical certificate within 3 days of returning. Medical emergencies require hospitalization documentation.
• **Official Duty**: Participation in university events, sports, or NCC/NSS with prior approval from HOD.
• **Department Permission**: Sponsored competitions, workshops with official letter.

Note: All exemptions require proper documentation and prior approval where possible.

**Attendance Calculation**

Formula: `(Classes Attended / Total Classes Held) × 100`

• Approximately **30 classes per week** across all subjects.
• Working days: Monday to Saturday.
• Lab sessions, tutorials, and quizzes count toward attendance.
• Late arrival by more than 10 minutes may be marked as absent.

**Consequences of Low Attendance (<75%)**

• You will **not be eligible** to write semester examinations.
• A **parental meeting** is mandatory if attendance drops below 60%.
• You must submit a **medical certificate** if absences were due to illness.
• Make-up classes may be arranged at the faculty's discretion.
• Repeat appearance in the subject requires paying full fees again.
